time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t * 24); frame 0 is t = 0
pixel_convention: x right, y DOWN, pixel-edge coordinates (a pixel column k spans k..k+1, so centres are (x0+x1)/2 of exclusive bbox)

camera.motion: static (frame 0 vs other frames: differences only at the pen; background identical to the pixel)
camera.view: front-on view of a blue wall with a table; motion plane (pen fall) is parallel to the image plane, 2D scene -> one metres-per-pixel scale
camera.perspective_cues: table top seen slightly from above (top surface visible y~865..895), so the camera is a little above table height; pen falls in front of the wall, lands near the back of the table top

objects.name: pen
objects.description: black/silver ballpoint pen (white-silver tip on the left, silver clip near centre), held horizontal; the only moving object
objects.visible_frames: 3-39 (frames 0-2: above the top image edge, not visible)
objects.reference_point: bbox centre of the pen (= pen centre/origin); x about 1025.0-1025.5 throughout

size_px.note: length = horizontal bbox width (pen within ~1-2 deg of horizontal); thickness ~6 px; no motion blur in render

objects.name: table
objects.description: long dark wood table top with black metal frame/legs, runs from behind AC unit's right side to x~1539

image_extents_px.legs: black legs at x~520-555 (left) and ~1500-1539 (right), continue below image bottom

objects.reliability: +-3 px; legs/bottom cut by frame edge so table height not measurable

objects.name: ac_outdoor_unit
objects.description: white LG air-conditioner outdoor unit with round fan grille, lower left

objects.name: cup_with_plant
objects.description: white cup/pot with small white-green succulent, on table right of pen

objects.name: wallet_or_phone_left
objects.description: flat dark rectangular object (phone/wallet) on table, left of pen

objects.name: remote_or_phone_right
objects.description: flat black object (remote / phone) on table, right of cup

objects.name: window_frame

events.event: release / start of fall (extrapolated, pen above frame)

events.event: pen enters view (fully visible at top edge)

frames 18 and 19 both at cy ~855.8 (~11 px above rest)
